1	"""The agent loop: a model reads a browser tab as text, decides what to do next, and acts.
2	
3	One `Agent` drives one `Tab`. Each turn the model gets its briefing, what its last actions did and the current page,
4	and answers with a thought and a short list of actions. The loop only carries those out; where to go, what to
5	search for, which record matters and when the job is finished are the model's calls.
6	"""
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	import asyncio
10	import hashlib
11	import json
12	import os
13	import re
14	import time
15	from typing import Awaitable, Callable
16	
17	import llm
18	from browser_env import Tab
19	
20	ACTIONS_HELP = """Reply with ONE JSON object: {"thought": "<one or two short sentences: what the page tells you and what you do next>", "actions": [ ... ]}.
21	The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
22	ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
23	Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].
24	
25	Browser actions:
26	  {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
27	  {"do": "click", "id": 12}
28	  {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
29	  {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
30	  {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
31	  {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
32	  {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
33	  {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
34	  {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
35	  {"do": "wait"}                                   pause two seconds, for a page that is still loading
36	  {"do": "done", "summary": "<ten words>", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one
37	
38	Reading the page:
39	- It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
40	  shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
41	  (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
42	- A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it. A page can hold several checks, one per
43	  area, also inside embedded frames further down: after passing one, look for the next LOCKED AREA and its own
44	  controls. A check whose status already reads as unlocked is done; setting it again changes nothing.
45	- A "toggle" opens or closes a section. If a section you opened stays empty after you unlocked it, click its toggle
46	  twice (close, then open) to load it again.
47	- Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
48	  lead and what their attributes say.
49	- Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
50	  after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.
51	"""
52	
53	STEP_TIMEOUT = 45  # seconds for one page read or one browser action: a hung page must not freeze the whole run
54	FULL_TURNS = 2  # how many past turns stay word for word; older ones keep the reasoning and drop the page text
55	NAVIGATING = {"click", "goto", "back", "reload", "login", "collect", "fetch"}
56	
57	
58	def state_fingerprint(observation: str) -> str:
59	    """A stable signature of the model-visible page state.
60	
61	    ``Tab.observe`` assigns fresh action ids on every read.  They are useful to
62	    the model, but must not make an unchanged page look like a successful
63	    action.  Removing only those generated ids keeps visible values, errors,
64	    dialogs and the URL in the comparison.
65	    """
66	    stable = re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "[]", observation)
67	    return hashlib.sha1(stable.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()
68	
69	
70	class Agent:
71	    def __init__(self, name: str, tab: Tab, system: str, briefing: Callable[[], str],
72	                 extra: dict[str, Callable[[dict], Awaitable[str]]] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None,
73	                 max_steps: int = 80, think: bool = False,
74	                 idle: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str | None]] | None = None,
75	                 guard: Callable[[dict], str | None] | None = None):
76	        """`briefing()` heads every turn. `extra` adds actions: name -> handler(action) -> result text.
77	        `idle("done")` lets the caller hold a finished agent until there is news for it (returns the news) or
78	        let it stop (returns None)."""
79	        self.name, self.tab, self.system, self.briefing = name, tab, system, briefing
80	        self.extra = extra or {}
81	        self.deadline = deadline or time.time() + 3600
82	        self.max_steps, self.think, self.idle = max_steps, think, idle
83	        self.guard = guard  # a sanity check that may veto a browser action before it runs (sanity.py)
84	        self.turns: list[dict] = []
85	        self.held: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # a collected or fetched document, until the agent moves on
86	        self.steps = 0
87	        self.started = time.time()
88	
89	    def document(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
90	        """What the agent is looking at: the document it collected or fetched, else the page as last read."""
91	        return self.held or (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)
92	
93	    def log(self, text: str) -> None:
94	        print(f"[{self.name} {self.steps:02d} t+{time.time() - self.started:.0f}s] {text}", flush=True)
95	
96	    def _messages(self, user: str) -> list[dict]:
97	        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self.system}]
98	        for index, turn in enumerate(self.turns):
99	            recent = index >= len(self.turns) - FULL_TURNS
100	            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": turn["user"] if recent else turn["short"]})
101	            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["assistant"]})
102	        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user})
103	        return messages
104	
105	    async def _browser(self, action: dict) -> str:
106	        do, tab = action.get("do"), self.tab
107	        if do == "login":
108	            return await tab.login()
109	        if do == "click":
110	            return await tab.click(action.get("id"))
111	        if do == "fill":
112	            return await tab.fill(action.get("id"), action.get("text", ""), bool(action.get("enter")))
113	        if do == "select":
114	            return await tab.select(action.get("id"), action.get("value", ""))
115	        if do == "set":
116	            return await tab.set(action.get("id"), action.get("value", True))
117	        if do == "goto":
118	            return await tab.goto(action.get("url", ""))
119	        if do == "back":
120	            return await tab.back()
121	        if do == "reload":
122	            return await tab.reload()
123	        if do == "collect":
124	            return await tab.collect(action.get("id"), action.get("max_pages") or 10)
125	        if do == "fetch":
126	            return await tab.fetch(action.get("id"))
127	        return f'unknown action "{do}"'
128	
129	    async def _alive(self) -> bool:
130	        try:
131	            return bool(await self.tab.page.main_frame.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-aid]').length > 0"))
132	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
133	            return False
134	
135	    async def run(self) -> dict:
136	        results: list[str] = []
137	        outcome = {"done": False, "summary": "", "answer": None, "steps": 0}
138	        self.log(f"starting at {self.tab.base_url}")
139	        if self.tab.page.url in ("", "about:blank"):
140	            try:

"""The agent loop: a model reads a browser tab as text, decides what to do next, and acts.

One `Agent` drives one `Tab`. Each turn the model gets its briefing, what its last actions did and the current page,
and answers with a thought and a short list of actions. The loop only carries those out; where to go, what to
search for, which record matters and when the job is finished are the model's calls.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import time
from typing import Awaitable, Callable

import llm
from browser_env import Tab

ACTIONS_HELP = """Reply with ONE JSON object: {"thought": "<one or two short sentences: what the page tells you and what you do next>", "actions": [ ... ]}.
The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].

Browser actions:
  {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
  {"do": "click", "id": 12}
  {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
  {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
  {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
  {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
  {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
  {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
  {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
  {"do": "wait"}                                   pause two seconds, for a page that is still loading
  {"do": "done", "summary": "<ten words>", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one

Reading the page:
- It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
  shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
  (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
- A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it. A page can hold several checks, one per
  area, also inside embedded frames further down: after passing one, look for the next LOCKED AREA and its own
  controls. A check whose status already reads as unlocked is done; setting it again changes nothing.
- A "toggle" opens or closes a section. If a section you opened stays empty after you unlocked it, click its toggle
  twice (close, then open) to load it again.
- Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
  lead and what their attributes say.
- Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
  after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.
"""

STEP_TIMEOUT = 45  # seconds for one page read or one browser action: a hung page must not freeze the whole run
FULL_TURNS = 2  # how many past turns stay word for word; older ones keep the reasoning and drop the page text
NAVIGATING = {"click", "goto", "back", "reload", "login", "collect", "fetch"}


def state_fingerprint(observation: str) -> str:
    """A stable signature of the model-visible page state.

    ``Tab.observe`` assigns fresh action ids on every read.  They are useful to
    the model, but must not make an unchanged page look like a successful
    action.  Removing only those generated ids keeps visible values, errors,
    dialogs and the URL in the comparison.
    """
    stable = re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "[]", observation)
    return hashlib.sha1(stable.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()


class Agent:
    def __init__(self, name: str, tab: Tab, system: str, briefing: Callable[[], str],
                 extra: dict[str, Callable[[dict], Awaitable[str]]] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None,
                 max_steps: int = 80, think: bool = False,
                 idle: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str | None]] | None = None,
                 guard: Callable[[dict], str | None] | None = None):
        """`briefing()` heads every turn. `extra` adds actions: name -> handler(action) -> result text.
        `idle("done")` lets the caller hold a finished agent until there is news for it (returns the news) or
        let it stop (returns None)."""
        self.name, self.tab, self.system, self.briefing = name, tab, system, briefing
        self.extra = extra or {}
        self.deadline = deadline or time.time() + 3600
        self.max_steps, self.think, self.idle = max_steps, think, idle
        self.guard = guard  # a sanity check that may veto a browser action before it runs (sanity.py)
        self.turns: list[dict] = []
        self.held: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # a collected or fetched document, until the agent moves on
        self.steps = 0
        self.started = time.time()

    def document(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """What the agent is looking at: the document it collected or fetched, else the page as last read."""
        return self.held or (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)

    def log(self, text: str) -> None:
        print(f"[{self.name} {self.steps:02d} t+{time.time() - self.started:.0f}s] {text}", flush=True)

    def _messages(self, user: str) -> list[dict]:
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self.system}]
        for index, turn in enumerate(self.turns):
            recent = index >= len(self.turns) - FULL_TURNS
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": turn["user"] if recent else turn["short"]})
            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["assistant"]})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user})
        return messages

    async def _browser(self, action: dict) -> str:
        do, tab = action.get("do"), self.tab
        if do == "login":
            return await tab.login()
        if do == "click":
            return await tab.click(action.get("id"))
        if do == "fill":
            return await tab.fill(action.get("id"), action.get("text", ""), bool(action.get("enter")))
        if do == "select":
            return await tab.select(action.get("id"), action.get("value", ""))
        if do == "set":
            return await tab.set(action.get("id"), action.get("value", True))
        if do == "goto":
            return await tab.goto(action.get("url", ""))
        if do == "back":
            return await tab.back()
        if do == "reload":
            return await tab.reload()
        if do == "collect":
            return await tab.collect(action.get("id"), action.get("max_pages") or 10)
        if do == "fetch":
            return await tab.fetch(action.get("id"))
        return f'unknown action "{do}"'

    async def _alive(self) -> bool:
        try:
            return bool(await self.tab.page.main_frame.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-aid]').length > 0"))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return False

    async def run(self) -> dict:
        results: list[str] = []
        outcome = {"done": False, "summary": "", "answer": None, "steps": 0}
        self.log(f"starting at {self.tab.base_url}")
        if self.tab.page.url in ("", "about:blank"):
            try:
                results.append(await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.goto(self.tab.base_url + "/"), STEP_TIMEOUT))
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                results.append(f"opening {self.tab.base_url} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload or try again")
        repeats, last_signature, failures = 0, "", 0
        stuck = 0  # page reads and navigations in a row that timed out or failed: the tab may be broken
        while self.steps < self.max_steps and time.time() < self.deadline:
            self.steps += 1
            clock = time.time()
            try:
                page = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                stuck += 1
                page = f"(the page did not finish loading within {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload it or go elsewhere)"
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                page = f"(the page could not be read: {str(error)[:200]})"
            results.extend(self.tab.take_events())
            done_text = "\n".join(f"{n}. {text}" for n, text in enumerate(results, 1)) or "(none yet)"
            left = int(self.deadline - time.time())
            user = (f"{self.briefing()}\n\nTIME LEFT: {left} s\n\nRESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text}\n\n"
                    f"CURRENT PAGE\n{page}")
            read_s = time.time() - clock
            clock = time.time()
            reply = await llm.chat_json(self._messages(user), think=self.think, label=self.name)
            model_s = time.time() - clock
            clock = time.time()
            actions = reply.get("actions")
            if isinstance(actions, dict):
                actions = [actions]
            if not isinstance(actions, list) or not actions:
                failures += 1
                if failures >= 4:
                    self.log("the model gave no usable actions four times; stopping")
                    break
                results = ['your reply had no "actions" list; reply with {"thought": ..., "actions": [...]}']
                continue
            failures = 0
            thought = str(reply.get("thought", ""))[:300]
            head = page.split("\n", 2)
            short = f"RESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text[:700]}\n\nPAGE (text dropped)\n" + "\n".join(head[:2])
            self.turns.append({"user": user, "short": short, "assistant": json.dumps(reply, ensure_ascii=False)})
            if os.environ.get("AGENT_TRACE"):  # what the agent saw and answered, one file per turn
                os.makedirs(os.environ["AGENT_TRACE"], exist_ok=True)
                with open(os.path.join(os.environ["AGENT_TRACE"], f"{self.name}_{self.steps:03d}.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                    handle.write(user + "\n\n===== REPLY =====\n" + json.dumps(reply, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))

            # A repeated action is a loop only if the model also sees the same
            # page.  A form may keep its URL while legitimately changing state.
            signature = json.dumps(actions, sort_keys=True) + state_fingerprint(page)
            repeats = repeats + 1 if signature == last_signature else 0
            last_signature = signature

            results, finished, moved = [], None, False
            for action in actions[:8]:
                if not isinstance(action, dict):
                    continue
                do = action.get("do")
                if do == "done":
                    finished = action
                    break
                if do == "wait":
                    await asyncio.sleep(2)
                    results.append("waited two seconds")
                    continue
                if do in self.extra:
                    try:
                        results.append(await self.extra[do](action))
                    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                        results.append(f"{do} failed: {str(error)[:200]}")
                    continue
                if moved:
                    results.append(f'skipped {json.dumps(action, ensure_ascii=False)[:120]}: the page changed, its ids are stale')
                    continue
                veto = self.guard(action) if self.guard else None
                if veto:
                    results.append(veto)
                    continue
                before = self.tab.page.url
                try:
                    result = await asyncio.wait_for(self._browser(action), STEP_TIMEOUT)
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result = f"{do} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s and was stopped; the page may be stuck"
                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                    result = f"{do} failed: {str(error)[:200]}"
                results.append(result)
                # Do not trust a successful browser call by itself: enterprise
                # portals often swallow a click or reject a field silently.
                # The next model turn gets a compact, actionable state-delta
                # report rather than assuming the dispatch took effect.
                if do not in ("collect", "fetch"):
                    try:
                        after = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
                        changed = state_fingerprint(page) != state_fingerprint(after)
                        if changed:
                            results.append(f"verification: {do} visibly changed the page state")
                        else:
                            results.append(f"verification: {do} caused no visible page change; inspect the control "
                                           "or try a different recovery path instead of repeating it blindly")
                    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                        results.append(f"verification: could not re-read the page within {STEP_TIMEOUT} s")
                    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                        results.append(f"verification: could not re-read the page ({str(error)[:160]})")
                if do in NAVIGATING:
                    failed = any(sign in str(result) for sign in ("Timeout", "timed out", "took longer", "detached", "ERR_ABORTED"))
                    stuck = stuck + 1 if failed else 0
                if do in ("collect", "fetch"):
                    self.held = (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)
                elif do in NAVIGATING:
                    self.held = None
                if do in NAVIGATING or self.tab.page.url != before or not await self._alive():
                    moved = True
            if stuck >= 2:  # the same tab failed twice in a row: carry on in a fresh one (browser_env.Tab.renew)
                stuck = 0
                try:
                    renewed = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.renew(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
                    results.append("this tab kept failing to load, so it was replaced by a fresh one: " + renewed)
                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                    results.append(f"replacing the stuck tab failed: {str(error)[:150]}")
                self.held = None
            self.log(f"(read {read_s:.1f}s, model {model_s:.1f}s, act {time.time() - clock:.1f}s) {thought} | "
                     f"{json.dumps(actions, ensure_ascii=False)[:400]} | " + " ; ".join(r[:160] for r in results))
            if repeats >= 2:
                results.append("You have sent the same actions three times with the same result: they do not work "
                               "here. Read the page again from the top for another way (a further check, a toggle, a "
                               "different link, a search), or finish with done.")
            if finished is not None:
                outcome.update(summary=str(finished.get("summary", "")), answer=finished.get("answer"))
                news = await self.idle("done") if self.idle else None
                if news is None:
                    outcome["done"] = True
                    break
                results.append(news)
        outcome["steps"] = self.steps
        return outcome

4	2. One agent per website explores it in its own browser. Each decides where to go, what to search for and which
5	   pages are evidence, and files those pages. A model call turns every filed page into structured facts in the
6	   shared case file; the open questions derived from the brief's rules tell all agents what is still missing, so a
7	   fact found on one website (a catalogue group, a key) steers the search on another.
8	3. `calculator.py` applies the bid rules to the facts: arithmetic only.
9	4. An agent enters the bid in the tender portal, has the mail agent fetch the signing TAN, and submits.
10	"""
11	from __future__ import annotations
12	
13	import asyncio
14	import json
15	import os
16	import sys
17	import time
18

21	import browsers

28	from casefile import SHAPES, CaseFile, read_context
29	from worker import ACTIONS_HELP, Agent

31	INVESTIGATOR = """You are one of several research agents preparing a tender bid for a manufacturer's sales
32	engineering team. Each agent works a different website at the same time; you work the website "{site}" at {url}
33	in your own browser tab. Together you must find every fact the bid rules need. You only find and file evidence:
34	you never calculate prices.
35	
36	TASK BRIEF (the rules are authoritative)
37	{brief}
38	END OF BRIEF
39	
40	{actions}
41	Case-file actions:
42	  {{"do": "keep", "kind": "<kind>", "note": "<what it is>"}}
43	      File the document in front of you (the current page, or the document you just collected or fetched) as
44	      evidence. Its facts are then extracted into the shared case file and reported back to you. Kinds:
45	        positions         the tender's bill of quantities
46	        clarifications    answers of the tender's bidder Q&A
47	        revisions         the revision history of the buyer's technical specification
48	        requirements      the requirement details of one specification revision
49	        material          ERP master data of materials: technical attributes, status, planning, stock
50	        price_conditions  ERP price conditions of one material: validity, currency, quantity scales
51	        mail              an opened mail message
52	  {{"do": "answer", "question": "<id>", "status": "complete" | "absent", "note": "..."}}
53	      Close an open question: "complete" when all its evidence is filed (needed for lists that only you know to be
54	      complete), "absent" when you searched properly and what is asked for does not exist.
55	
56	How to work
57	- Every turn starts with the case file and the OPEN QUESTIONS. Work on the questions your website can answer;
58	  the other agents handle the rest. Facts they file show up in the case file and can open new questions for you.
59	- You remember only the page in front of you: file a relevant page with keep BEFORE you leave it. keep files the
60	  whole document, also what was cut from your view. File a document once, with the right kind. Facts on a page only
61	  enter the CASE FILE when you call keep on that page; reading a value in your thought without calling keep leaves
62	  the case file unchanged.
63	- File pages that state the facts themselves (an opened document, record or message), not menus or hit lists.
64	  For a paged list or document that matters, use collect so that no page is missed, then keep it. For stock
65	  availability, drill down from plant/physical summaries into storage locations to view freely available
66	  (unrestricted) stock excluding blocked/inspection stock, and file that page with keep.
67	- The websites hold traps: superseded revisions, look-alike records for other tender references, drafts and
68	  previews, blocked materials, future-dated records, values in the wrong unit or number format. Check dates,

"""RFQ-to-bid: a team of model-directed agents, one per website, and a deterministic calculator.

1. The model reads the brief: which tender, which date, which senders the rules authorize.
2. One agent per website explores it in its own browser. Each decides where to go, what to search for and which
   pages are evidence, and files those pages. A model call turns every filed page into structured facts in the
   shared case file; the open questions derived from the brief's rules tell all agents what is still missing, so a
   fact found on one website (a catalogue group, a key) steers the search on another.
3. `calculator.py` applies the bid rules to the facts: arithmetic only.
4. An agent enters the bid in the tender portal, has the mail agent fetch the signing TAN, and submits.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

import browsers
import llm
import run as contract
from browser_env import Tab
from calculator import calculate_bid
import sanity
import validate
from casefile import SHAPES, CaseFile, read_context
from worker import ACTIONS_HELP, Agent

INVESTIGATOR = """You are one of several research agents preparing a tender bid for a manufacturer's sales
engineering team. Each agent works a different website at the same time; you work the website "{site}" at {url}
in your own browser tab. Together you must find every fact the bid rules need. You only find and file evidence:
you never calculate prices.

TASK BRIEF (the rules are authoritative)
{brief}
END OF BRIEF

{actions}
Case-file actions:
  {{"do": "keep", "kind": "<kind>", "note": "<what it is>"}}
      File the document in front of you (the current page, or the document you just collected or fetched) as
      evidence. Its facts are then extracted into the shared case file and reported back to you. Kinds:
        positions         the tender's bill of quantities
        clarifications    answers of the tender's bidder Q&A
        revisions         the revision history of the buyer's technical specification
        requirements      the requirement details of one specification revision
        material          ERP master data of materials: technical attributes, status, planning, stock
        price_conditions  ERP price conditions of one material: validity, currency, quantity scales
        mail              an opened mail message
  {{"do": "answer", "question": "<id>", "status": "complete" | "absent", "note": "..."}}
      Close an open question: "complete" when all its evidence is filed (needed for lists that only you know to be
      complete), "absent" when you searched properly and what is asked for does not exist.

How to work
- Every turn starts with the case file and the OPEN QUESTIONS. Work on the questions your website can answer;
  the other agents handle the rest. Facts they file show up in the case file and can open new questions for you.
- You remember only the page in front of you: file a relevant page with keep BEFORE you leave it. keep files the
  whole document, also what was cut from your view. File a document once, with the right kind. Facts on a page only
  enter the CASE FILE when you call keep on that page; reading a value in your thought without calling keep leaves
  the case file unchanged.
- File pages that state the facts themselves (an opened document, record or message), not menus or hit lists.
  For a paged list or document that matters, use collect so that no page is missed, then keep it. For stock
  availability, drill down from plant/physical summaries into storage locations to view freely available
  (unrestricted) stock excluding blocked/inspection stock, and file that page with keep.
- The websites hold traps: superseded revisions, look-alike records for other tender references, drafts and
  previews, blocked materials, future-dated records, values in the wrong unit or number format. Check dates,
  references, senders and status marks before you rely on a record, and follow the brief's rules on which one
  counts. When in doubt, file both and let the facts decide.
- Follow the search hints a website gives. If a search returns nothing or too much, change the search terms.
- When a question asks for every item in a list, inspect its page controls and use collect on the control that
  advances that list before filing it. Check the resulting page count or end state; do not mark a list complete after
  seeing only its first page. If the list is inside an embedded document, use the controls belonging to that document.
- For mailbox questions, search relevant folders separately when mailbox search covers only the current folder;
  include the archive when looking for historical or latest records. If a query is too broad or returns nothing,
  refine the terms and try again. Open candidate messages and file the message itself, not only its hit row.
- If the news says extraction failed or found no usable records, do not mark that question complete. Reopen the
  evidence page, check that it contains the records requested, and file it again with the right kind.
- When no open question is left that your website can answer right now, finish with done, also when you need
  facts the other agents have not filed yet. You are called again as soon as the case file brings new questions.
  Never idle with wait and never browse around to pass the time.
"""


class Team:
    """Holds an agent that has nothing to do until the case file brings news, and ends the investigation when every
    agent is idle and no filed document is still being read."""

    def __init__(self, case: CaseFile, names: list[str], deadline: float):
        self.case, self.names, self.deadline = case, set(names), deadline
        self.idle: set[str] = set()
        self.finished = asyncio.Event()

    def hook(self, name: str):
        async def hold(why: str) -> str | None:
            version = self.case.version
            before = {qid for qid, _ in self.case.questions()}
            self.idle.add(name)
            try:
                while not self.finished.is_set() and time.time() < self.deadline:
                    changed = await self.case.wait_change(version, 1.0)
                    if self.finished.is_set():
                        break
                    if changed:
                        version = self.case.version
                        fresh = {qid for qid, _ in self.case.questions()} - before
                        if fresh or self.case.news.get(name):
                            return "The case file has news" + (f"; new open questions: {', '.join(sorted(fresh))}" if fresh else "") + "."
                    elif self.idle == self.names and self.case.pending == 0:
                        self.finished.set()
                return None
            finally:
                self.idle.discard(name)
        return hold


def investigator(case: CaseFile, team: Team, tab: Tab, deadline: float) -> Agent:
    name = tab.site_id
    system = INVESTIGATOR.format(site=name, url=tab.base_url, brief=case.brief, actions=ACTIONS_HELP)

    def briefing() -> str:
        questions = case.questions()
        news = case.take_news(name)
        text = f"CASE FILE\n{case.status()}\n\nOPEN QUESTIONS\n"
        text += "\n".join(f"- [{qid}] {question}" for qid, question in questions) or "(none)"
        if news:
            text += "\n\nNEWS FROM YOUR FILED DOCUMENTS\n" + "\n".join(f"- {item}" for item in news)
        own_pending = case.pending_for(name)
        if own_pending:
            text += f"\n\n({own_pending} filed document(s) are still being read.)"
        elif case.pending:
            text += f"\n\n({case.pending} document(s) filed by other agents are still being read.)"
        return text

    agent: Agent

    async def keep(action: dict) -> str:
        document, source = agent.document()
        res = case.file(str(action.get("kind", "")), document, source, name)
        if res.startswith("this document is already filed"):
            res += "; do not file this same page again — check OPEN QUESTIONS for what is missing on another page, or finish with done"
        return res

    async def answer(action: dict) -> str:
        # A completion action can arrive in the same turn as `keep`. Wait for this agent's own
        # extraction result (up to 45 s) instead of blocking on slow extractions from other websites.
        wait_until = min(deadline, time.time() + 45.0)
        while case.pending_for(name) and time.time() < wait_until:
            version = case.version
            if case.pending_for(name):
                await case.wait_change(version, min(1.0, max(0.0, wait_until - time.time())))
        if case.pending_for(name):
            return "Evidence extraction is still pending and the investigation deadline is near; do not repeat this answer action."
        return case.answer(str(action.get("question", "")).strip("[] "), str(action.get("status", "")), str(action.get("note", "")), agent=name)

    # Navigation runs without the model's thinking: about twice as fast. The facts themselves are read by the
    # extraction calls in casefile.py, which keep thinking on. AGENT_THINK=1 turns it back on for comparison.
    agent = Agent(name, tab, system, briefing, extra={"keep": keep, "answer": answer}, deadline=deadline,
                  max_steps=int(os.environ.get("AGENT_MAX_STEPS", "150")), idle=team.hook(name),
                  think=os.environ.get("AGENT_THINK") == "1")
    return agent


async def open_tabs(playwright, sites: list[dict]) -> tuple[list, dict[str, Tab]]:
    """One tab per website: a browser each while the run has enough of them, else further tabs in the last one."""
    count = max(1, len(browsers.cdp_urls()) or min(len(sites), 4))
    opened, tabs, pages = [], {}, []
    for number in range(min(count, len(sites))):
        browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright, number)
        opened.append(browser)
        pages.append(page)
    for index, site in enumerate(sites):
        page = pages[index] if index < len(pages) else await pages[-1].context.new_page()
        tabs[site["siteId"]] = Tab(page, site)
    return opened, tabs


async def solve(task: dict, playwright) -> dict | None:
    started = time.time()
    sites = [site for site in task.get("access") or [] if isinstance(site, dict) and site.get("siteId") and site.get("url")]
    only = {name for name in os.environ.get("AGENT_SITES", "").split(",") if name}
    if not sites or not task.get("brief"):
        return None
    brief = task["brief"]
    listing = "\n".join(f"- {site['siteId']}: {site['url']}" for site in sites)
    context = await read_context(brief + f"\n\nThe websites of this run:\n{listing}")
    case = CaseFile(brief, context)
    print(f"Sanity checks on: {', '.join(sanity.active()) or 'none'}", flush=True)
    print(f"Context: tender {case.reference}, scenario {case.scenario.isoformat()}, company {case.company}, "
          f"senders {case.senders}", flush=True)

    left = contract.seconds_left(task)
    budget = min(left, 20 * 60) if left != float("inf") else 20 * 60  # a scored run has 20 minutes
    hard_stop = started + budget - 45
    # The bid form takes ~2 min and the signing code another 1-2 min; a signed partial bid scores, an unsigned
    # complete one does not. So the investigation ends with 8 minutes left (sandbox test run 54c78c38: 330 s was
    # too little and the run ended unsigned).
    submit_reserve = min(480, budget * 0.4)
    investigate_until = hard_stop - submit_reserve

    opened, tabs = await open_tabs(playwright, sites)
    try:
        working = [tab for name, tab in tabs.items() if not only or name in only]
        team = Team(case, [tab.site_id for tab in working], investigate_until)
        async def bounded(tab):  # an agent stuck past the deadline is stopped so that the others' facts still count
            limit = max(10.0, investigate_until - time.time() + 20)
            try:
                return await asyncio.wait_for(investigator(case, team, tab, investigate_until).run(), limit)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                team.finished.set()
                return RuntimeError(f"stopped after {limit:.0f} s: still busy at the investigation deadline")
        outcomes = await asyncio.gather(*(bounded(tab) for tab in working), return_exceptions=True)
        for tab, outcome in zip(working, outcomes):
            print(f"[{tab.site_id}] finished: {outcome if isinstance(outcome, Exception) else json.dumps(outcome, ensure_ascii=False)[:300]}", flush=True)
        for _ in range(40):  # facts of the last filed documents
            if not case.pending:
                break
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

        facts = case.inputs()
        bid = calculate_bid(case.reference, case.scenario, facts.governing, facts.positions, facts.clarifications,
                            facts.requirements, facts.materials, facts.authorities, facts.no_material)
        issues = []
        if sanity.enabled("validator"):
            bid, issues = validate.check(bid, {p.position for p in facts.positions} or None)
        if issues:
            print("VALIDATOR: " + " | ".join(issues), flush=True)
        print(f"Investigation took {time.time() - started:.0f} s. {llm.summary()}", flush=True)
        print("CASE FILE\n" + case.status(), flush=True)
        print("OPEN QUESTIONS LEFT: " + (", ".join(qid for qid, _ in case.questions()) or "none"), flush=True)
        print("BID: " + json.dumps(bid.answer(), ensure_ascii=False) + f" omitted={bid.omitted} notes={bid.notes}", flush=True)
        if os.environ.get("AGENT_DUMP"):
            with open(os.environ["AGENT_DUMP"], "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                handle.write(case.dump())
        if os.environ.get("AGENT_SKIP_SUBMIT") == "1":
            return bid.answer()

        submission = task.get("submission") or {}
        tender_tab = tabs.get(submission.get("siteId")) or next(
            (tab for tab in tabs.values() if submission.get("url", "").startswith(tab.base_url)), None)
        mail_tab = tabs.get(str(context.get("mail_site") or ""))
        if submission.get("kind") == "site" and tender_tab is not None:
            import submit
            receipt = await submit.submit_bid(
                tender_tab, mail_tab, bid,
                {"tender_reference": case.reference, "scenario_date": case.scenario.isoformat(), "company": case.company,
                 "vat_id": case.vat_id, "email": case.mailbox or ""}, brief, hard_stop)
            print(f"Submission: {json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False)[:600]}. Total {time.time() - started:.0f} s. {llm.summary()}", flush=True)
        return bid.answer()
    finally:
        for browser in opened:
            try:
                await browser.close()
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass


async def main() -> int:
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    print(f"Run {task.get('run_id')}: {len(task.get('access') or [])} site(s), {contract.seconds_left(task):.0f}s left.", flush=True)
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        answer = await solve(task, playwright)
    if not answer:
        print("No answer to submit; exiting cleanly.")
    elif (task.get("submission") or {}).get("kind") == "site":
        print(f"Answer worked out for the site: {json.dumps(answer)}")
    elif not token:
        print(f"Answer (local run, not submitted): {json.dumps(answer)}")
    else:
        status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
        print(f"Submitted answer -> HTTP {status}: {body}")
        return 0 if status < 300 else 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

"""A conservative, no-model checklist for the tender portal's review page.

The clerk decides when it has reached a review page.  This module only reports
what the accessible page proves and blocks finalisation on explicit errors or
unfilled required controls; it never invents portal-specific field mappings.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

from calculator import Bid

ERROR = re.compile(r"\b(error|invalid|failed|missing|fehler|ungültig|pflichtfeld)\b", re.I)
EMPTY_REQUIRED = re.compile(r"^(?=.*\(required\))(?=.*(?:value=\"\"|\[unchecked\])).*$", re.I)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Report:
    ready: bool
    blockers: tuple[str, ...]
    warnings: tuple[str, ...]
    checks: tuple[str, ...]

    def text(self) -> str:
        state = "READY" if self.ready else "BLOCKED"
        lines = [f"PRE-SUBMISSION CHECKLIST: {state}", *[f"- {item}" for item in self.checks]]
        lines += [f"- BLOCKER: {item}" for item in self.blockers]
        lines += [f"- WARNING: {item}" for item in self.warnings]
        return "\n".join(lines)


def _money(value: Decimal) -> set[str]:
    fixed = f"{value:.2f}"
    whole, cents = fixed.split(".")
    return {fixed, fixed.replace(".", ","), f"{int(whole):,}.{cents}", f"{int(whole):,}".replace(",", ".") + "," + cents}


def check(page: str, bid: Bid, reference: str) -> Report:
    """Report review-page evidence without assuming a portal's labels or layout."""
    visible = re.sub(r"\[\d+\] ", "", page)
    lower = visible.lower()
    blockers: list[str] = []
    warnings: list[str] = []
    checks: list[str] = []
    errors = [line.strip() for line in visible.splitlines() if ERROR.search(line)]
    required = [line.strip() for line in visible.splitlines() if EMPTY_REQUIRED.match(line)]
    if errors:
        blockers.append("the portal reports: " + " | ".join(errors[:3])[:500])
    else:
        checks.append("no explicit portal error is visible")
    if required:
        blockers.append("a required control is empty or unchecked: " + " | ".join(required[:3])[:500])
    else:
        checks.append("no empty required control is visible")
    if reference and reference.lower() in lower:
        checks.append(f"tender reference {reference} is visible")
    else:
        warnings.append(f"tender reference {reference} is not visible on this page")
    expected = [line.position for line in bid.lines]
    missing = [position for position in expected if not re.search(rf"(?<![\w.-]){re.escape(position)}(?![\w.-])", visible)]
    if missing:
        warnings.append("offered position(s) not visible in this review: " + ", ".join(missing))
    else:
        checks.append("every offered position is visible")
    amounts = _money(Decimal(bid.total_net))
    if any(amount in visible for amount in amounts):
        checks.append("calculated total is visible")
    else:
        warnings.append("calculated total is not visible on this page")
    return Report(not blockers, tuple(blockers), tuple(warnings), tuple(checks))

34	{brief}

41	{sheet}

45	  declining, and still sign and submit it.
46	- "positions" has one entry per tender position that is offered. Enter each under its own position number.

48	  these values.

50	  another notation (a decimal comma, a unit, whole numbers for weeks and pieces): follow its hints, placeholder
51	  and error messages. Change the notation only, never the value.

59	      A colleague who has the bidder's mailbox open in another browser looks for it and answers. This is how you
60	      get the signing code (TAN) the portal sends by mail. Ask only after you have triggered the code in the
61	      portal, and pass on what you know about it (the tender reference, that you requested it just now, anything
62	      the portal displayed about it): the mailbox also holds older codes that no longer work.
63	  {{"do": "check_submission"}}

66	  {{"do": "finalize", "id": 12}}

72	- A bid form asks, in an order of its own, for things like the bidder's details, bid or no bid, the positions,

75	- Read the form's own instructions: when entries are saved, what going back does, which fields are required.
76	  Do the fields of a page in one reply, then the control that saves them or moves on.
77	- After each step look at the result. If the form reports an error or did not keep a value, correct that field
78	  before you move on.

89	  done without "answer" and say why in "summary".

92	"""
93	
94	COURIER = """You have the sales mailbox of a bidding company open in the webmail "{site}" at {url}, in your own
95	browser tab. A colleague is entering the company's bid for tender {reference} in the tender portal right now and
96	asks you for something from the mailbox, usually the one-time signing code (TAN) the portal has just mailed.
97	
98	{actions}
99	
100	How to work
101	- The request heads every turn, together with the answers you gave earlier in this run.
102	- Codes expire. The mailbox can hold older codes, codes for other tenders whose references look alike, and
103	  unrelated mail with similar subjects. The one that counts is the newest message that matches the request. Open
104	  the message itself and check its reference and time before you answer: a row in a list is not enough.
105	- Lists can be paged, sorted either way and split over folders, and new mail may only show after a reload. If the
106	  message is not there yet, reload and look again a few times.
107	- Log in again if the webmail asks.
108	- Finish with done and put ONLY the value asked for in "answer": a code exactly as written, nothing around it.
109	  If you cannot find it, finish with done without "answer" and say in "summary" what you saw instead.
110	"""
111	
112	
113	def _amount(value: Decimal | None) -> str | None:
114	    return None if value is None else f"{value:.2f}"
115	
116	
117	def bid_sheet(bid: Bid) -> dict:
118	    """The bid as the clerk gets it: the answer's fields with exact amounts as text, the positions left out, and per
119	    position the offered material's attributes for forms that have the bidder configure the product."""
120	    positions = []
121	    for line in bid.lines:
122	        material = line.material
123	        positions.append({
124	            "position": line.position, "material_number": line.material_number,
125	            "material": None if material is None else {
126	                "bore_mm": material.bore_mm, "stroke_mm": material.stroke_mm, "pressure_bar": material.pressure_bar,
127	                "mounting": material.mounting, "certification": material.certification},
128	            "quantity": line.quantity, "unit_price": _amount(line.unit_price),
129	            "lead_time_weeks": line.lead_time_weeks, "base_unit_price": _amount(line.base_unit_price),
130	            "surcharge_per_unit": _amount(line.surcharge_per_unit),
131	            "packaging_per_unit": _amount(line.packaging_per_unit), "rebate_total": _amount(line.rebate_total)})
132	    discount = Decimal(bid.discount_percent)
133	    return {"tender_reference": bid.tender_reference, "decision": bid.decision, "currency": "EUR",
134	            "discount_percent": int(discount) if discount == discount.to_integral_value() else float(discount),
135	            "positions": positions, "omitted_positions": list(bid.omitted), "total_net": _amount(bid.total_net)}
136	
137	
138	async def submit_bid(tender_tab: Tab, mail_tab: Tab | None, bid: Bid, context: dict, brief: str,
139	                     deadline: float) -> dict:
140	    """Have an agent enter, sign and submit `bid` in the tender portal before `deadline` (a time.time() value).
141	
142	    `context` holds tender_reference, scenario_date, company, vat_id and email. Returns {"submitted", "receipt",
143	    "notes"}: `receipt` is the portal's confirmation as the agent read it, empty when there was none.
144	    """
145	    reference = str(context.get("tender_reference") or bid.tender_reference)
146	    guard = sanity.TypingGuard() if sanity.enabled("typing_guard") else None
147	    codes: list[str] = []  # what the mailbox handed out so far: a used code must not be handed out again
148	    review: Report | None = None
149	
150	    # The courier gets a fresh tab in the mailbox's browser (same session), opened now in the background while the
151	    # bid form is filled: the investigators' tab can be left half-navigated by the deadline that stopped them, and
152	    # a cold mailbox costs minutes when the signing code is waiting (sandbox test run 54c78c38).
153	    courier_tab: Tab | None = None
154	    warming = None
155	    if mail_tab is not None:
156	        try:
157	            page = await mail_tab.page.context.new_page()
158	            courier_tab = Tab(page, {"siteId": mail_tab.site_id, "url": mail_tab.base_url,
159	                                     "credentials": mail_tab.credentials})
160	            warming = asyncio.ensure_future(courier_tab.goto(courier_tab.base_url + "/"))
161	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  no second tab: fall back to the investigators' one
162	            courier_tab = mail_tab
163	
164	    async def ask_mail(action: dict) -> str:
165	        task = str(action.get("task") or "").strip()
166	        if not task:
167	            return 'ask_mail needs a "task": say what you need from the mailbox and how to recognise it'
168	        if courier_tab is None:
169	            return "there is no mailbox in this run, so nothing can be fetched by mail"
170	        if warming is not None and not warming.done():
171	            try:

173	            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  the courier opens the page itself then
174	                pass
175	
176	        def request() -> str:
177	            text = f"REQUEST FROM YOUR COLLEAGUE AT THE TENDER PORTAL\n{task}"
178	            if codes:
179	                text += ("\n\nANSWERS YOU GAVE EARLIER IN THIS RUN (they are used up: a new request needs a newer "
180	                         "message)\n" + "\n".join(f"- {code}" for code in codes))

183	        system = COURIER.format(site=courier_tab.site_id, url=courier_tab.base_url, reference=reference,
184	                                actions=ACTIONS_HELP)

186	                        max_steps=COURIER_STEPS, think=COURIER_THINKS)
187	        outcome = await courier.run()
188	        answer = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
189	        if not answer:
190	            return "the mailbox colleague found nothing: " + (outcome.get("summary") or "no result in the time given")
191	        codes.append(answer)
192	        if guard is not None:
193	            guard.allow(answer)  # read from the mailbox during the run: the clerk may type it
194	        return f'the mailbox colleague answers: "{answer}"' + (f' ({outcome["summary"]})' if outcome.get("summary") else "")
195	
196	    async def check_submission(action: dict) -> str:

200

208

211	        text = f"YOUR JOB: enter, sign and submit the bid for tender {reference}, then read the confirmation."
212	        if codes:
213	            text += "\nCodes from the mailbox so far, oldest first: " + ", ".join(codes)
214	        if left < WRAP_UP:

218	
219	    bidder = {"company": context.get("company"), "vat_id": context.get("vat_id"), "email": context.get("email")}
220	    sheet = bid_sheet(bid)
221	    system = CLERK.format(site=tender_tab.site_id, url=tender_tab.base_url, brief=brief, reference=reference,
222	                          bidder=json.dumps(bidder, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1),

224	    if sanity.enabled("no_guessed_mailbox") and not bidder.get("email"):
225	        system += ("\nTHE BIDDER'S E-MAIL ADDRESS IS NOT KNOWN YET. If the form asks for it, get it with ask_mail (the "

227	                   "make up an address, not even a plausible one.\n")

- A bid form asks, in an order of its own, for things like the bidder's details, bid or no bid, the positions,
  the commercial terms, declarations, a review and a signature. Read each page and give it what it asks for,
  from the bidder data and the bid sheet. Fill every field the sheet has a value for, optional ones included.
- Read the form's own instructions: when entries are saved, what going back does, which fields are required.
  Do the fields of a page in one reply, then the control that saves them or moves on.
- After each step look at the result. If the form reports an error or did not keep a value, correct that field
  before you move on.
- Declarations: read what each one says. Give the confirmations a valid bid needs; leave unticked, or untick,
  options that would alter the bid or have nothing to do with it.
- On the review page compare what the form lists with the bid sheet: reference, decision, every position, the
  discount and the total. Go back and correct differences while there is time.
- Signing: trigger the code in the portal, get it with ask_mail, enter it and submit. A submission is final.
  If the portal rejects a code, request a fresh one instead of trying the same again.
- On the final review page, call check_submission. If it is BLOCKED, correct the reported issue and check again.
  Use finalize for the final irreversible confirmation only after it reports READY.
- You are finished only when the portal confirms that the bid was received. Then finish with done and put the
  confirmation (its receipt number or code, else its wording) in "answer". If you cannot submit, finish with
  done without "answer" and say why in "summary".
- Watch the time. A bid that is entered but not submitted scores nothing; a submitted bid with positions left
  out keeps the points of the positions it holds. When the head of a turn says time is short, do as it says.
"""

COURIER = """You have the sales mailbox of a bidding company open in the webmail "{site}" at {url}, in your own
browser tab. A colleague is entering the company's bid for tender {reference} in the tender portal right now and
asks you for something from the mailbox, usually the one-time signing code (TAN) the portal has just mailed.

{actions}

How to work
- The request heads every turn, together with the answers you gave earlier in this run.
- Codes expire. The mailbox can hold older codes, codes for other tenders whose references look alike, and
  unrelated mail with similar subjects. The one that counts is the newest message that matches the request. Open
  the message itself and check its reference and time before you answer: a row in a list is not enough.
- Lists can be paged, sorted either way and split over folders, and new mail may only show after a reload. If the
  message is not there yet, reload and look again a few times.
- Log in again if the webmail asks.
- Finish with done and put ONLY the value asked for in "answer": a code exactly as written, nothing around it.
  If you cannot find it, finish with done without "answer" and say in "summary" what you saw instead.
"""


def _amount(value: Decimal | None) -> str | None:
    return None if value is None else f"{value:.2f}"


def bid_sheet(bid: Bid) -> dict:
    """The bid as the clerk gets it: the answer's fields with exact amounts as text, the positions left out, and per
    position the offered material's attributes for forms that have the bidder configure the product."""
    positions = []
    for line in bid.lines:
        material = line.material
        positions.append({
            "position": line.position, "material_number": line.material_number,
            "material": None if material is None else {
                "bore_mm": material.bore_mm, "stroke_mm": material.stroke_mm, "pressure_bar": material.pressure_bar,
                "mounting": material.mounting, "certification": material.certification},
            "quantity": line.quantity, "unit_price": _amount(line.unit_price),
            "lead_time_weeks": line.lead_time_weeks, "base_unit_price": _amount(line.base_unit_price),
            "surcharge_per_unit": _amount(line.surcharge_per_unit),
            "packaging_per_unit": _amount(line.packaging_per_unit), "rebate_total": _amount(line.rebate_total)})
    discount = Decimal(bid.discount_percent)
    return {"tender_reference": bid.tender_reference, "decision": bid.decision, "currency": "EUR",
            "discount_percent": int(discount) if discount == discount.to_integral_value() else float(discount),
            "positions": positions, "omitted_positions": list(bid.omitted), "total_net": _amount(bid.total_net)}


async def submit_bid(tender_tab: Tab, mail_tab: Tab | None, bid: Bid, context: dict, brief: str,
                     deadline: float) -> dict:
    """Have an agent enter, sign and submit `bid` in the tender portal before `deadline` (a time.time() value).

    `context` holds tender_reference, scenario_date, company, vat_id and email. Returns {"submitted", "receipt",
    "notes"}: `receipt` is the portal's confirmation as the agent read it, empty when there was none.
    """
    reference = str(context.get("tender_reference") or bid.tender_reference)
    guard = sanity.TypingGuard() if sanity.enabled("typing_guard") else None
    codes: list[str] = []  # what the mailbox handed out so far: a used code must not be handed out again
    review: Report | None = None

    # The courier gets a fresh tab in the mailbox's browser (same session), opened now in the background while the
    # bid form is filled: the investigators' tab can be left half-navigated by the deadline that stopped them, and
    # a cold mailbox costs minutes when the signing code is waiting (sandbox test run 54c78c38).
    courier_tab: Tab | None = None
    warming = None
    if mail_tab is not None:
        try:
            page = await mail_tab.page.context.new_page()
            courier_tab = Tab(page, {"siteId": mail_tab.site_id, "url": mail_tab.base_url,
                                     "credentials": mail_tab.credentials})
            warming = asyncio.ensure_future(courier_tab.goto(courier_tab.base_url + "/"))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  no second tab: fall back to the investigators' one
            courier_tab = mail_tab

    async def ask_mail(action: dict) -> str:
        task = str(action.get("task") or "").strip()
        if not task:
            return 'ask_mail needs a "task": say what you need from the mailbox and how to recognise it'
        if courier_tab is None:
            return "there is no mailbox in this run, so nothing can be fetched by mail"
        if warming is not None and not warming.done():
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(warming), 20)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  the courier opens the page itself then
                pass

        def request() -> str:
            text = f"REQUEST FROM YOUR COLLEAGUE AT THE TENDER PORTAL\n{task}"
            if codes:
                text += ("\n\nANSWERS YOU GAVE EARLIER IN THIS RUN (they are used up: a new request needs a newer "
                         "message)\n" + "\n".join(f"- {code}" for code in codes))
            return text

        system = COURIER.format(site=courier_tab.site_id, url=courier_tab.base_url, reference=reference,
                                actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
        courier = Agent("courier", courier_tab, system, request, deadline=min(deadline, time.time() + MAIL_BUDGET),
                        max_steps=COURIER_STEPS, think=COURIER_THINKS)
        outcome = await courier.run()
        answer = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
        if not answer:
            return "the mailbox colleague found nothing: " + (outcome.get("summary") or "no result in the time given")
        codes.append(answer)
        if guard is not None:
            guard.allow(answer)  # read from the mailbox during the run: the clerk may type it
        return f'the mailbox colleague answers: "{answer}"' + (f' ({outcome["summary"]})' if outcome.get("summary") else "")

    async def check_submission(action: dict) -> str:
        nonlocal review
        review = check_review(await tender_tab.observe(), bid, reference)
        return review.text()

    async def finalize(action: dict) -> str:
        nonlocal review
        # Navigation, expiry and server validation can invalidate an earlier review, so inspect it again.
        review = check_review(await tender_tab.observe(), bid, reference)
        if not review.ready:
            return review.text() + "\nFinal submission was not pressed."
        return await tender_tab.click(action.get("id"))

    def heading() -> str:
        left = int(deadline - time.time())
        text = f"YOUR JOB: enter, sign and submit the bid for tender {reference}, then read the confirmation."
        if codes:
            text += "\nCodes from the mailbox so far, oldest first: " + ", ".join(codes)
        if left < WRAP_UP:
            text += (f"\nTIME IS SHORT ({left} s). Enter no further positions: leave out the ones not entered yet if "
                     "the form allows it, go straight to the signature, fetch the code and submit what is entered.")
        return text

    bidder = {"company": context.get("company"), "vat_id": context.get("vat_id"), "email": context.get("email")}
    sheet = bid_sheet(bid)
    system = CLERK.format(site=tender_tab.site_id, url=tender_tab.base_url, brief=brief, reference=reference,
                          bidder=json.dumps(bidder, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1),
                          sheet=json.dumps(sheet, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
    if sanity.enabled("no_guessed_mailbox") and not bidder.get("email"):
        system += ("\nTHE BIDDER'S E-MAIL ADDRESS IS NOT KNOWN YET. If the form asks for it, get it with ask_mail (the "
                   "mailbox colleague can read the address of the mailbox it has open) and type exactly that. Never "
                   "make up an address, not even a plausible one.\n")
    if guard is not None:
        guard.allow(sheet)
        guard.allow(bidder)
        guard.allow(reference)
    clerk = Agent("submit", tender_tab, system, heading,
                  extra={"ask_mail": ask_mail, "check_submission": check_submission, "finalize": finalize}, deadline=deadline,
                  max_steps=CLERK_STEPS, think=CLERK_THINKS, guard=guard)
    outcome = await clerk.run()
    receipt = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
    notes = str(outcome.get("summary") or "")
    if not outcome.get("done"):
        notes = (notes + " " if notes else "") + f"stopped after {outcome.get('steps', 0)} steps without a confirmation"
    return {"submitted": bool(outcome.get("done") and receipt), "receipt": receipt, "notes": notes}

649	    def answer(self, question: str, status: str, note: str, agent: str | None = None) -> str:
650	        """An agent closes a question: its evidence is complete, or the thing does not exist."""
651	        open_ids = {qid for qid, _ in self.questions()}
652	        if question not in open_ids:
653	            return f'"{question}" is not an open question'
654	        if status not in ("complete", "absent"):
655	            return 'status must be "complete" or "absent"'
656	        if self.pending_for(agent):
657	            return "facts from documents you filed are still being extracted; wait for them, then answer"
658	        if question == "clarifications" and status == "complete" and not self.clarifications:
659	            return "no Q&A answers have been extracted yet; reopen the Q&A evidence, file it as clarifications, and wait for the extraction result"
660	        if question.startswith("material:") and status == "absent":
661	            facts = self.inputs()
662	            answers = active_clarifications(facts.clarifications, self.scenario)
663	            needs, _ = resolve_requirements(facts.requirements, facts.governing, answers, facts.authorities)
664	            need = needs.get(question.split(":", 1)[1])
665	            group = [m for m in facts.materials if need and need.catalogue_group and same_text(m.catalogue_group, need.catalogue_group)]
666	            unknown = [m.number for m in group if m.active is None or None in (m.bore_mm, m.stroke_mm, m.pressure_bar, m.mounting)]

669	            if unknown:

671	        if status == "complete" and question.split(":")[0] in ("positions", "revision", "requirements", "reserve", "material", "data"):
672	            return "this question closes by itself once the facts are on file; file the missing evidence instead"
673	        self.answers[question] = (status, note)
674	        self._bump()
675	        return f"question {question} closed as {status}"

1	"""Sanity checks against model hallucinations, as switchable plugins. Plain code: no model call, no real cost.
2	
3	Every check has a name, the stage where it hooks in and a status. `SANITY_CHECKS` picks which run:
4	    unset or "default"   every implemented check
5	    "all"                the same (planned checks are skipped until they exist)
6	    "none"               none of them
7	    "typing_guard,validator"   exactly these
8	so that the same version can be run with and without a check and the scores compared.
9	"""
10	from __future__ import annotations
11	
12	import os

94	    """Allows the clerk to type only what our data holds. `allow()` adds values learned during the run (a code the

97	    def __init__(self, *sources):

99	        self.numbers: set[Decimal] = set()

103	    def allow(self, source) -> None:
104	        values: list = []
105	        _leaves(source, values)
106	        for value in values:
107	            text = _clean(value)
108	            if not text:
109	                continue
110	            self.texts.add(text.casefold())
111	            number = _as_number(text) if not isinstance(value, (int, float, Decimal)) else Decimal(str(value))
112	            if number is not None:
